disruptions.summary: Reduced service between Aylesbury Vale Parkway and London Marylebone via Amersham today
disruptions.description:
A fault with the signalling system between Aylesbury Vale Parkway and London Marylebone via Amersham means fewer trains are able to run on all lines. As a result, some trains operating between these stations will be cancelled or revised.

This is expected to be the case until the end of the day.

Check before you travel:

You can check your journey using the National Rail real-time Journey Planner.

Compensation:

You may be entitled to compensation if you experience a delay in completing your journey today. Please keep your train ticket and make a note of your journey, as both will be required to support any claim.
